Rap Hip Hop

🎧 The Professional Hip Hop Old School & DJ Anthology

Set 1: The Foundations & West Coast Groove

Mid-tempo vibes to set the tone.

  • California Love – 2Pac (feat. Dr. Dre)

  • Can I Get A… – Jay-Z

  • Da Dip – Freak Nasty

  • Baby Got Back – Sir Mix-A-Lot

  • Bling Bling – B.G.

  • Blow The Whistle – Too $hort

  • Doin’ It – LL Cool J

  • Feelin’ Myself – Mac Dre

  • Get Stupid – Mac Dre

  • Get Your Freak On – Missy Elliott

  • Gettin’ Jiggy Wit It – Will Smith

  • Gimme Some More – Busta Rhymes

  • Goin’ Down – E-40

  • Got Your Money – Ol’ Dirty Bastard

  • Gotta Man – Eve

  • Grillz – Nelly

  • Holla – Ja Rule

  • Horse & Carriage – Cam’ron

  • Hot Boyz – Missy Elliott

  • Hot In Herre – Nelly

  • The Humpty Dance – Digital Underground

  • Hypnotize – Notorious B.I.G.

  • I Wanna Rock (Doo Doo Brown) – Luke

  • ✨ ENHANCEMENT: Nuthin’ But A ‘G’ Thang – Dr. Dre & Snoop Dogg

Set 2: Lyricists & East Coast Anthems

Classic 90s flow and storytelling.

  • Just A Friend – Biz Markie

  • Love Is Blind – Eve

  • Lose Yourself – Eminem

  • Mona Lisa – Slick Rick

  • Mo Money Mo Problems – Notorious B.I.G.

  • Money Maker – Ludacris

  • Me So Horny – 2 Live Crew

  • Can I Kick It? – A Tribe Called Quest

  • Because I Got High – Afroman

  • Intergalactic – Beastie Boys

  • Boom! Shake The Room – DJ Jazzy Jeff & The Fresh Prince

  • Let Me Clear My Throat – DJ Kool

  • Party Up (Up In Here) – DMX

  • Ready Or Not – Fugees

  • Get Low – Lil Jon & The East Side Boyz

  • Act A Fool – Ludacris

  • Empire State of Mind (New York) – Jay-Z

  • This Is How We Do It – Montell Jordan

  • Shimmy Shimmy Ya – Ol’ Dirty Bastard

  • ✨ ENHANCEMENT: Juicy – Notorious B.I.G.

Set 3: The Dirty South & Crowd Participators

Peak hour energy and choreographed dances.

  • Hey Ya! – Outkast

  • Ms. Jackson – Outkast

  • So Fresh, So Clean – Outkast

  • The Way You Move – Outkast

  • C’mon N’ Ride It (The Train) – Quad City DJ’s

  • Boombastic – Shaggy

  • Drop It Like It’s Hot – Snoop Dogg

  • You’re A Jerk – New Boyz

  • Tie Me Down – New Boyz

  • Cupid Shuffle – Cupid

  • Cha Cha Slide – DJ Casper

  • Drop It Low – Ester Dean

  • No Pigeons – Sporty Thievz

  • Nostradamus – Nas

  • Notorious B.I.G. – Notorious B.I.G.

  • One More Chance (Remix) – Notorious B.I.G.

  • Rapper’s Delight – Sugarhill Gang

  • Ruff Ryders’ Anthem – DMX

  • Shake What Ya Mama Gave Ya – James “JT” Money

  • Short Dick Man – 20 Fingers

  • Smack That – Akon

  • South Bronx – Boogie Down Productions

  • Tell Me When To Go – E-40

  • The Bridge – MC Shan

  • ✨ ENHANCEMENT: Knuck If You Buck – Crime Mob

Set 4: The Heavy Hitters & Club Closers

High-energy bangers to finish the set.

  • Vivrant Thing – Q-Tip

  • What Ya Want – Eve

  • Who Am I? (What’s My Name?) – Snoop Dogg

  • White Lines – Grandmaster Flash & Melle Mel

  • Who Do You Love? – LL Cool J

  • Whoomp! (There It Is) – Tag Team

  • Step In The Name Of Love – R. Kelly

  • Low – Flo Rida

  • How Low – Ludacris

  • It’s All About The Benjamins – Puff Daddy

  • Back That Azz Up – Juvenile

  • Be Faithful – Fatman Scoop

  • You Can Do It – Ice Cube

  • Big Poppa – Notorious B.I.G.

  • Regulate – Warren G & Nate Dogg

  • ✨ ENHANCEMENT: In Da Club – 50 Cent

Bonus DJ Enhancement Pack

If you need to extend the night, these three fit the “Top Rap/Old School” criteria perfectly:

  1. Rob Base & DJ EZ Rock – It Takes Two (The ultimate transition song).

  2. Naughty By Nature – Hip Hop Hooray (Best for crowd participation).

  3. Salt-N-Pepa – Push It (Classic old school dance energy).
